# T-1: Model child process supervision

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add the class-owned timeout, escalation, settlement, and cleanup behavior for one spawned child process.

## Acceptance Criteria
- ChildProcessSupervisor sends SIGTERM to the managed tree at timeout and force-terminates the full tree after the bounded grace period on POSIX and win32.
- AgentTimeoutError represents a completed timeout escalation.
- Terminal events settle once, wait for direct close and tree-dead observation, and always remove timers and listeners.

## Implementation Notes
Keep class ownership limited to lifecycle observation and termination. Use detached POSIX process groups with negative-PGID signaling and tree-dead probing; use taskkill /T /F for win32 forced cleanup. Preserve Agent responsibilities outside that boundary.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests use controlled child fixtures for SIGTERM ignore, close/timeout race, and spawn error.
